title: Imperial Cusco
short_description: Experience Cusco, the City Tour, Sacred Valley, Machu Picchu, Humantay Lake and Rainbow Mountain in 5 days of history, culture and adventure.
long_description:
Welcome to the historic capital of the Inca Empire. Cusco awaits with ancient charm, historic streets and spectacular landscapes.

During this 5-day, 4-night journey, explore Cusco's archaeological sites, the Sacred Valley, Machu Picchu, Humantay Lake and Rainbow Mountain.
price_note: From USD 485 per person. Subject to availability.

days.title: Day 1: Cusco City Tour
days.text: Explore Cusco's historic center, Cathedral and Qorikancha, followed by Sacsayhuamán, Qenqo, Puka Pukara and Tambomachay. Return near Cusco's main square.

days.title: Day 2: Sacred Valley – Ollantaytambo
days.text: Travel from Cusco to Chinchero, Moray and the Maras Salt Mines. Enjoy a buffet lunch in Urubamba and visit Ollantaytambo before boarding the train.

days.title: Day 3: Machu Picchu
days.text: Travel by tourist train to Aguas Calientes. Our guide accompanies you by bus to Machu Picchu for the assigned circuit. After free time, return by train and tourist transportation to Cusco.

days.title: Day 4: Humantay Lake
days.text: Depart early for Humantay Lake. After breakfast, begin a 1.5-to-2-hour hike. Enjoy the scenery and guide's explanation, followed by buffet lunch and return to Cusco.

days.title: Day 5: Rainbow Mountain – Departure
days.text: Travel to Cusipata for breakfast and hike to Rainbow Mountain. After the visit and lunch, return to Cusco. Airport transfer must be coordinated according to the flight schedule.
